_doc: Year omens: as each year turns, the seers foretell one omen for a season of it. While that season lasts its numbers fold into the season's own (yields multiply, mood and arrivals add, menace and warband multiply, marchDays add, heroes adds to the daily chance a hero walks in, sick multiplies how fast sickness spreads). The first year's omen never lands in its first season.
foretold: The seers of {town} read the year's sky: {omen} {when}. {text}

omens.name: A harsh winter
omens.comes: The cold bites early and the snow lies deep. The armies keep to their fires.

omens.name: A bumper harvest
omens.text: The barns will want to be bigger.
omens.comes: The sheaves stand thick in every field and the carts groan under them.

omens.name: The blood moon
omens.text: The things in the wilds will be hungry. Man the walls.
omens.comes: The moon rises red over the hills, and the wilds answer it.

omens.name: Fair winds
omens.text: Travellers will come. Have beds for them.
omens.comes: The roads are dry, the rivers kind, and every road brings someone to the gate.

omens.name: The long rains
omens.text: The building will go slowly, but the fields will drink.
omens.comes: The rain comes and does not stop. Mortar will not set and every lane is mud.

omens.name: A comet
omens.text: Heroes read such signs. They will come looking for fortune.
omens.comes: A comet hangs over the town hall with a tail like a drawn sword. Strangers with swords follow it in.

omens.name: A plague year
omens.text: Keep the wells clean and the healers close.
omens.comes: Flies thick in the air, and a cough in every lane. Sickness spreads fast this season.

omens.name: Quiet roads
omens.text: A breath before the storm. Use it.
omens.comes: The roads fall quiet. The lairs in the wilds sleep, and the raiders keep away.

omens.name: A drought
omens.text: The wells will run low. Store what grain you can.
omens.comes: No rain for weeks. The river drops and the crops curl in the fields.

omens.name: A mild winter
omens.text: The builders will not have to stop.
omens.comes: The snow is thin and soon gone. The masons keep working through it.
